title: Unauthenticated Request Fallback Grants Superadmin Privilege
description: The authenticateToken middleware in server/index.js defaults unauthenticated requests to the superadmin role when the Authorization token is missing or fails signature verification.
root_cause: Fallback assignment of superadmin role in the authentication middleware error handling branch instead of returning HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
intended_behavior: Requests without a valid signed JWT must be rejected with HTTP 401 Unauthorized and not assigned any principal credentials.

trace.description: Incoming HTTP request reaches authenticateToken middleware
Absence of token evaluates true and assigns req.user with superadmin role
Calls next() with active superadmin credentials without authentication

evidence.description: Source code assigns req.user with superadmin role when token is falsy

conditions.description: Unauthenticated client sending request without Authorization header

instructions: Send GET request to protected endpoint /api/candidates without Authorization header
Observe the response payload and status code
execution.observed_result: Server returns HTTP 200 with all candidate records as superadmin

remediation.strategy: Return res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Unauthorized' }) when token is missing or invalid in authenticateToken middleware

code_changes.fixed_code: if (!token) { return res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Unauthorized: Access token is required' }); }

likelihood.reason: Trivial to trigger by sending any standard HTTP request without an Authorization header

impact.reason: Grants complete administrative control over all candidate profiles, notes, requisitions, and system data

confidence.reason: Directly demonstrated in source code and observable in runtime execution

title: Permissive Wildcard Cross-Origin Resource Sharing
description: The Express application initializes CORS with wildcard defaults allowing any third-party web origin to perform cross-origin requests.
root_cause: Calling app.use(cors()) without an origin allowlist configuration.
intended_behavior: CORS should be configured with an explicit origin allowlist matching the production domains.

trace.description: app.use(cors()) registers global wildcard CORS middleware

conditions.description: Express server configured with unconstrained cors() middleware

execution.attacker_perspective: Malicious third-party website in user browser
instructions: Send an HTTP request with Origin header http://attacker.com
execution.observed_result: Server responds with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * enabling cross-origin reads

remediation.strategy: Specify origin allowlist in cors options including https://smarthireus.com and https://www.smarthireus.com

likelihood.reason: Requires inducing an authenticated recruiter to visit an attacker-controlled webpage

impact.reason: Allows unauthorized cross-origin reading of API responses

confidence.reason: Directly visible in server middleware declaration and response headers

title: Fallback Hardcoded JWT Secret Key in Server Runtime
description: JWT_SECRET constant falls back to a hardcoded predictable string if process.env.JWT_SECRET is unset in the environment.
root_cause: Hardcoded default secret string smarthire_secure_jwt_secret_key_2026 committed directly in source code.
intended_behavior: JWT secret must be injected solely via secure environment variables and must fail fast if undefined.

trace.description: JWT_SECRET initialized with logical OR fallback to hardcoded string
jwt.verify verifies signature against the fallback secret key

conditions.description: Server instance running without an explicitly configured JWT_SECRET environment variable

execution.attacker_perspective: External adversary with read access to source repository
instructions: Forge a JWT using the known secret key with role superadmin
Send forged token in Authorization header to /api/candidates
execution.observed_result: jwt.verify succeeds and grants superadmin privileges to the forged token

remediation.strategy: Require JWT_SECRET from environment and throw fatal error if undefined

code_changes.fixed_code: if (!process.env.JWT_SECRET) { throw new Error('FATAL: JWT_SECRET environment variable must be defined'); }

likelihood.reason: The secret key is publicly visible in version control and easily extracted

impact.reason: Allows generating valid administrative credentials for any user account or role

confidence.reason: Directly visible on line 28 of server/index.js

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting in Resume Document Viewer
description: The /api/candidates/view-resume route interpolates the untrusted query parameter name into the HTML document without HTML escaping.
root_cause: Direct template literal interpolation of candName into raw HTML inside the inline doc viewer response.
intended_behavior: All dynamic user or query parameters interpolated into HTML responses must be HTML entity encoded.

trace.description: candName concatenated into docViewerHtml template literal
res.send(docViewerHtml) sends unescaped markup to browser

evidence.description:
${candName}
interpolates raw unescaped query parameter

conditions.description: Recruiter clicks a crafted view-resume URL containing HTML/script tags in the name parameter

execution.attacker_perspective: External attacker sending phishing link to recruiter
instructions: Load the craft URL with script tag in name parameter
execution.observed_result: Script tag is rendered directly into the DOM and executes within the smarthireus.com origin

remediation.strategy: Apply HTML escaping to candName before interpolating into HTML template

code_changes.fixed_code:
const escapeHtml = (s) => String(s || '').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"');
const safeCandName = escapeHtml(candName);

likelihood.reason: Easily triggered by clicking a link containing URL-encoded script payload

impact.reason: Allows hijacking the recruiter session, stealing tokens from localStorage, or performing unauthorized actions

confidence.reason: Demonstrated through direct source inspection on lines 2277 and 2656
